name: SushiSwap
description: SushiSwap is the most multi-chain DEX, powered by its industry's most advanced swap and aggregation stack across 40+ chains.

methodology.UserFees: Users pay a 0.3% fee on each trade.
methodology.Fees: SushiSwap Classic charges a flat 0.3% fee.
methodology.Revenue: A share of each trade fee goes to xSUSHI stakers.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Treasury does not receive SushiSwap Classic swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: A share of each trade fee goes to xSUSHI stakers.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Liquidity providers receive 5/6 of swap fees from trades in their pools.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap Classic pools.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users on SushiSwap Classic pools.

Revenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: The 1/6 protocol fee share from SushiSwap Classic swaps.

HoldersRevenue.Swap Fees To xSUSHI Stakers: The 1/6 protocol fee share from SushiSwap Classic swaps.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Liquidity Providers: The 5/6 fee share retained by liquidity providers.
